messages:
avi: FYI launching an "entropy-trim" pass next week to remove unused admin entitlements and sanity-check KMS bindings before the auditor run. Plan: owner attest -> small canary demotion -> staged removals + rollback playbooks.

nina: What's the stale cutoff? We should avoid knocking monthly cron jobs.

corey: Proposal: 90d for humans, 180d for service accounts by default. Honor tags: `monthly-run=true`, `ci-exempt=true`. Also include a quarterly whitelist.

sec-bot: preflight report: scanned 2,110 principals; flagged 129 admin-level bindings; 41 KMS keys with non-owner principals. Snapshot uploaded: gs://compliance-snaps/2475001111/before.json (immutable).

avi: (typo: meant avi) — owner ping draft: "Hi @owner, security will review entitlements on `<resource>`. `<principal>` holds `<role>` and shows no activity since `<last_seen>`. Please attest or tag `entropy-exempt=true` within 7 days or the entitlement will be demoted. See compliance snapshot: gs://compliance-snaps/2475001111/"

corey: KMS safety — run an impersonated decrypt probe before changing key policies. Example:
```bash
# impersonate and attempt decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=kr --key=k --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --project=proj --impersonate-service-account=${PRINCIPAL} || echo "decrypt-failed"
```
If the probe fails, label `needs-owner-attest` and skip auto-removal.

nina: We'll need immutable CSV for audit: principal, role, resource, last_seen, kms_probe_result, owner_contact, recommended_action, reapply_command. Auditor wants retention >=7y.

auditor: Confirming CSV schema above works. Also require an attestation URL recorded per principal and linked to ticket history. Store snapshots and attestations in compliance storage with ACLs restricted to compliance+security.

avi: Action items:
- corey: implement decrypt probe + tag detection (ETA Wed)
- sec-bot: produce CSV and upload immutable snapshot (ETA Tue)
- nina: assemble quarterly whitelist and owner-contact mapping (ETA Thu)
- avi: prepare automation PR, canary batch list, and rollback playbooks (ETA Fri)

corey: Canary schedule: demote 6 low-risk bindings Monday 09:00 PT for 48h. Pause if >2 failed jobs or any KMS decrypt errors. We'll wire a webhook to #eng-oncall for alerts.

avi: Typo again — (meant nina is ack). Thanks, team. Keeping thread pinned for live canary updates. :lock:
